rationale.conceptual: The method involves performing spin-polarized DFT, applying five strain distortions, fitting to quadratic, solving linear system, Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging, Debye temperature from elastic constants — multi-part standard but non-trivial technique requiring careful implementation and knowledge of solid-state physics.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline with many sequential DFT calculations (geometry optimization, reference elemental calculations, series of strain-energy runs), requiring orchestration of numerous simulation steps, I/O parsing, post-processing, and tolerance for convergence; error-prone without scripting.

difficulty.reasoning: Reproducing DFT elastic/thermal properties of Fe2Mo requires a multi-step workflow of non-trivial solid-state physics calculations, implemented via a complex orchestration of many CPU DFT jobs and post-processing, but the underlying method is well-established.

compute_estimate.reasoning: 12-atom unit cell, moderate k-point density; each DFT run is CPU-bound and memory-light, no large datasets.
